name: Letlhogonolo Fanampe
headline: AI Solutions Engineer | Production LLM Applications, RAG & Agentic Automation | Python, FastAPI & LangChain
tagline: AI Assistants • RAG Systems • Workflow Automation
summary: I build and deploy AI applications that connect business knowledge, data and workflows. My work spans retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), SQL assistants, API integrations, document processing and AI quality evaluation.
availability: Available immediately for AI Solutions Engineer, AI Engineer and LLM application engineering opportunities, including remote and hybrid roles.
about: At Kwantu, I developed RAG and SQL chatbot solutions using Python, FastAPI, LangChain and vector databases. My work included multilingual information retrieval, WhatsApp and Telegram integrations, OCR pipelines, and deployment on Linux with systemd and Nginx.

Through work with Outlier and Translated, I have also evaluated model responses, designed prompts and contributed human feedback for AI training. That experience informs how I test applications for accuracy, relevance and failure cases.

Before moving into software, I spent eight years in AfriSam’s cement laboratory. That work taught me to check data carefully, investigate unexpected results and make processes reproducible. I started learning Python in 2022 and developed my skills through projects and AI hackathons.

music.summary: Co-founded Papzin & Crew with Gabriel Matshabe in 2016. The platform features mega-mixes, Cruize Friday mixes, online radio and custom mix requests.

experience.title: Freelance AI Engineer
bullets: Build AI applications and developer tools using Python, language models and external APIs.
Developed VocalThread to turn YouTube comments into spoken dialogues through the ElevenLabs API.
Contributed to TruthGuard as an AI Specialist on the team; the project explores news classification with Llama 3 and Together AI.
Created Agent Handoff Kit, an open-source Python/SQLite prototype for recovering interrupted local work from checkpoints and suppressing duplicate effects within a local transaction.
Collaborate in Lablab.ai and Devpost hackathons to prototype, integrate and demonstrate AI applications.

experience.title: AI Training Data Specialist | RLHF & Prompt Engineering
bullets: Evaluated and ranked text and image-model responses for factual accuracy, coherence, relevance and adherence to task guidelines.
Designed prompts and adversarial tests to identify reasoning errors, unsafe outputs and other model failure cases.
Verified training data and reviewed peer submissions for correctness and consistency with evaluation criteria.
Documented model weaknesses and refined prompts and responses to support reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

experience.title: AI/ML Engineer (RAG, SQL & OCR)
bullets: Built RAG assistants for PDF documents and SQL databases using Python, LangChain, FastAPI, OpenAI embeddings, FAISS and DeepLake, including multilingual retrieval.
Built an ID-document processing pipeline covering data cleaning, Label Studio annotation, Detectron2 training and OCR with Tesseract and PaddleOCR.
Integrated chatbot services with FastAPI, the WhatsApp Business API and Telegram, using models and APIs including Mixtral and Together AI.
Deployed and maintained services on CentOS/Linux with systemd and Nginx; diagnosed connectivity and API issues.
Resolved schema mismatches, SQL query issues, API rate limits and inconsistent LLM responses across retrieval and processing pipelines.

experience.title: AI Prompt Evaluator

Fact-checked, rated and ranked responses for accuracy, relevance and completeness.
Rewrote responses to improve clarity and adherence to task requirements, and documented content needing additional review.

experience.title: AI/ML Engineer — Computer Vision

experience.title: Laboratory Analyst & Assistant

projects.name: Agent Handoff Kit
projects.summary: A Python and SQLite recovery prototype that resumes interrupted local work from a durable checkpoint. Its guarantees apply to the local database, not external APIs.
projects.detail: The demo interrupts one worker and lets a replacement resume, keeping one durable receipt and verifying unchanged replay. No model API keys or pip dependencies are needed for the local demo.

projects.name: AgentOps Mobile Command Center
projects.imageAlt: AgentOps dashboard for agent workflows, model routing and approvals
projects.summary: Connects a FastAPI dashboard and Telegram commands to a SQLite run log for goals, approvals, history and model routing. Demo mode works without provider credentials; live integrations require configuration.
projects.detail: Includes a recorded demo, Docker setup and optional integrations with model providers.

projects.name: TruthGuard
